actual retry counts and bounded delay/budget diagnostics. Preserve recovery policy.

fix(gateway): sync retained ranxi scheduler and diagnostics fixes

Pipeline bounded scheduler snapshot reads while preserving generation fencing,
missing-metadata misses and fresh LRU values. Record Grok error detail through
the existing opt-in, bounded Ops path and share its limit rule with existing
OpenAI error handlers. Diagnose Responses selection failures using the mapped
forward model while keeping client aliases in error messages.

authorization and image files are unchanged. Keep local BPS recovery, ownership,
cyber and attachment safeguards; exclude new regional, priority and operations
subsystems. Adopt only the two mapped-model call-site fixes from #418, not its
additional capacity-diagnosis contract. Preserve original integration provenance
and record each decision and existing manifest drift separately.

full vet, server build and four manual-release checks pass. A before-code overlay
reproduces the false 404 caught by the new handler regression. No new public
interfaces, configuration, migration, retry policy or main execution path.
